official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) Put a core from the Void and any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit, and when cores are put, you can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Silver Awaken] or [Silver Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Silver Awaken]", "give [Silver Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
